title: Camera Buff
description: A Polish factory worker (Jerzy Stuhr) embraces filmmaking after recording his daughter's birth.

title: Tugboat Annie
description: A tugboat captain (Marie Dressler) and her tipsy husband (Wallace Beery) see their son (Robert Young) go on to bigger things.

title: Emma
description: Children sue their former nanny (Marie Dressler) after their father (Jean Hersholt), whom she weds, leaves her his fortune.

title: Vanity Fair
description: A 19th-century story, now updated to the 1930s, tells of an irrepressible and intelligent Englishwoman who is determined to advance her position.

title: The Wet Parade
description: Alcohol and Prohibition catch up to the patriarchs (Walter Huston, Lewis Stone) of two families, North and South.

title: New Morals for Old
description: Proper parents have a son (Robert Young) who wants to go to Paris, and a daughter (Margaret Perry) in love with a married man.

title: Love Me Tonight
description: Mistaken for a baron, a singing Paris tailor (Maurice Chevalier) woos a princess (Jeanette MacDonald) at her castle.

title: Thirteen Women
description: Remembering the slights she suffered at the hands of her classmates, a young woman plans an unusual form of vengeance.

title: The Mask of Fu Manchu
description: Fiendish Fu forces archaeologists and a Scotland Yard inspector to the relics of Genghis Khan.

title: The Animal Kingdom
description: A publisher (Leslie Howard) marries a socialite (Myrna Loy) instead of the artist (Ann Harding) he loves.

title: The Thin Man
description: The recently divorced Gilbert discovers that his new girlfriend has stolen $50,000 and is carrying on with other men. Not long afterward, he disappears. Anxious to locate her father, Gilbert's daughter goes to private detective Nick Charles for help.

title: After the Thin Man
description: Urbane Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) look for a cousin's missing husband and find murder.

title: Another Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) visit a Long Island estate, where Nick drinks Scotch and solves murders.

title: Shadow of the Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles solve racetrack-related murders with their 4-year-old son and dog, Asta.

title: The Thin Man Goes Home
description: Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) visit his hometown, sober, and link art and corpses to a spy ring.

title: Song of the Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) solve a floating-casino murder with a jazz clarinetist (Keenan Wynn).

title: Calling Dr. Kildare
description: Young Dr. Kildare (Lew Ayres) treats a hoodlum for gunshot wounds without telling Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore).

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: The Bad Man
description: A Mexican bandit (Wallace Beery) pays back the indebted rancher (Lionel Barrymore) who saved his life.

title: Journey for Margaret
description: A U.S. journalist (Robert Young) with a childless wife (Laraine Day) meets an orphan boy and girl (Margaret O'Brien) in World War II London.

title: Mr. Lucky
description: A floating-casino operator (Cary Grant) cons an heiress (Laraine Day) into having games of chance at a ball for the war effort.

title: Bride by Mistake
description: A pilot (Alan Marshal) woos a woman (Marsha Hunt) doubling for an heiress (Laraine Day), then elopes with the heiress.

title: The Locket
description: Flashbacks show why a psychiatrist (Brian Aherne) warned a man not to marry his ex-wife (Laraine Day).

title: Woman on Pier 13
description: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: All That Heaven Allows
description: Friends and family want a rich widow (Jane Wyman) to end her romance with a tree surgeon (Rock Hudson) about 15 years her junior.

title: Leave Her to Heaven
description: While on a train, a writer strikes up a relationship with an attractive woman. She becomes obsessed and abandons her fiancé to be with the writer. Only after their marriage does he realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable.

title: The Trouble With Harry
description: Rural Vermonters try to bury a corpse, more than once.

title: The Cobweb
description: The director (Richard Widmark) of a psychiatric clinic presides over the crisis of selecting new curtains for the library.

title: The Daytrippers
description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him.

title: Sweet November
description: A tragic New Yorker (Sandy Dennis) loves a different man a month; the one for November (Anthony Newley) wants to stay.

title: Outward Bound
description: A ship sails on with a businessman, a snob, a suicidal couple (Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Helen Chandler) and others between two worlds.

title: Smilin' Through
description: A Victorian Englishman's (Leslie Howard) niece (Norma Shearer) and her suitor (Fredric March) resemble his long-dead bride and tragic rival.

title: Romeo and Juliet
description: Shakespeare's Renaissance lovers (Norma Shearer, Leslie Howard) tragically defy their feuding parents.

title: The Petrified Forest
description: An intellectual (Leslie Howard) and others are held hostage by a gangster (Humphrey Bogart) at an Arizona gas station/diner.

title: It's Love I'm After
description: An infatuated debutante (Olivia de Havilland) renews a Shakespearean actor's (Leslie Howard) running feud with his leading lady (Bette Davis).

title: Pygmalion
description: Professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) bets he can teach a cockney flower girl (Wendy Hiller) how to speak and act like a duchess.

title: 49th Parallel
description: A U-boat Nazi (Eric Portman) and his comrades raid a Canadian outpost, hijack a seaplane and kill to reach the United States.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur (Graham Chapman) goes questing on a pretend horse, followed by his lackey clacking coconut shells.

title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
description: In biblical times a man, mistakenly proclaimed a messiah, finds himself leader of a new religious movement.

title: Monty Python's The Meaning of Life
description: The British troupe's (Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Terry Gilliam) sketches include gluttony, birth control and total insignificance.

title: Yentl
description: A young woman charms her bearded roommate and a merchant's daughter while posing as a Talmudic schoolboy in circa-1900 Poland.

title: What's Up, Doc?
description: A music professor (Ryan O'Neal) visits San Francisco with his fiancée (Madeline Kahn) and meets a kooky woman (Barbra Streisand).

title: Elmer the Great
description: A country bumpkin-turned-baseball player foils crooked pitchers and racketeers conspiring to fix the World Series.

title: Random Harvest
description: An amnesiac World War I British veteran (Ronald Colman) marries a chorus girl (Greer Garson), then forgets her.

title: Anthony Adverse
description: The hero (Fredric March) finds his wife (Olivia de Havilland) has become an opera star and mistress to Napoleon Bonaparte.

title: They Won't Forget
description: A Southern lynch mob and a district attorney (Claude Rains) say a Northern teacher (Edward Norris) killed a teenager.

title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
description: An innocent man is sent to a prison farm, where he endures the dehumanizing effects of a cruel criminal justice system.

title: Little Caesar
description: An aspiring small-town criminal relocates to Chicago to hit the big time, accompanied by his buddy, but once there they find their paths taking them in drastically different directions.

title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo
description: Lt. Col. James Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads B-25s off the USS Hornet's deck on a 1942 mission to bomb Japan.
